name: Kindred Rewards
author: dockett

sections.description:
Kindred Rewards brings a loyalty program to WooCommerce: points on every completed order, a signup bonus, referral rewards for both sides, and point redemption as single-use WooCommerce coupons. Customers see their balance on their account page and with shortcodes; merchants manage members, the points ledger, redemptions and referrals from a dedicated admin menu.

Highlights
* Points on every completed order (no monthly-order cap)
* Signup bonus
* Referral program (referrer + referee bonuses)
* Redemption as WooCommerce coupons
* Balance widget, shortcodes and My Account tab
* Points ledger and member lists

The full version with points expiry, birthday bonuses, VIP tiers, review-point rewards, advanced widgets, email integrations, the full REST API, analytics, and white-label and agency tools is available from the plugin website.

Premium Features

The free version above is fully functional with no monthly-order cap. Paid plans are planned and not yet purchasable; only the Free plan is available right now. Prices below are the planned monthly prices.

Free — $0 (available now)

Everything in the free version: points on every completed order, signup bonus, referral program (referrer and referee), redemption as single-use WooCommerce coupons, balance widget, shortcodes, My Account tab, points ledger, and CSV-ready member lists.

Starter — $5 per month (planned)

Points expiry, birthday points, points reminders, custom earn rate.

Pro — $19 per month (planned)

VIP tiers (Bronze, Silver, Gold), review points, advanced widgets, email integrations, social sharing.

Accelerator — $134 per month (planned)

Full REST API, analytics, multisite, priority support.

Studio — $200 per month (planned)

White-label, concierge migration, SLA support, agency toolkit.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate “Kindred Rewards” through the Plugins screen.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to Kindred Rewards → Settings to configure earn rates and bonuses.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. Kindred Rewards awards points on WooCommerce orders and redeems points as WooCommerce coupons.

How do customers earn points?

Automatically when an order is marked completed, plus a signup bonus on registration and referral bonuses on a referred customer’s first completed order.

How do customers redeem points?

From their account page or the [kindred_rewards] shortcode; redeemed points become a single-use discount coupon.

Is there a monthly-order cap on the free plan?

No. Kindred Rewards has no monthly-order cap.
